method_identity.model_condition: containment is conditional on the model: an affine wall-vs-monotonic relation with native departure bounded by the frozen 250 us model-departure allowance. The justification for that condition is the authenticated network-time-OFF admission required of every prospective claim-bearing capture; the fit is not a substitute for that environmental control
method_identity.span_term_dependency: the anchor half-width H covers anchor PLACEMENT while the wall-minus-monotonic span term covers within-capture wall-versus-elapsed drift, which is load-bearing because the detector maps the trace at rate 1 from the anchor midpoint while pulse commands carry wall-epoch stamps. Removing either term breaks containment. Dropping the span term is lawful ONLY together with re-mapping the trace under the fitted rate window, under a new method identity. The earlier double-charge characterization is RETIRED: the only true overlap is the 250 us allowance widening H while real departures also inflate the span, a priced <=~0.5 ms conservatism

methodology_review_adjudication.bias_finding: the predecessor's rate=1 assumption is measurably false by several ppm; its knife-edge intersections placed anchor midpoints with a rate-drift bias of order drift/2. methodology_review_adjudication.outlier_mechanism_note: The +4.72 ms b_fiducial delta on 20260818T045736-4d9e9db9 is NOT explained by the anchor shift alone: that member's anchor point moves only +0.27 ms and its B_anchor only +0.32 ms. The remainder is detector-refit sensitivity under the shifted anchor -- accepted regions jumping sample quanta, which changes which edge is worst -- so the delta is fail-closed and widening, not a containment loss.

residual_margin_distribution.interpretation: the reported quantity is an UPPER bound produced by 24 bisections of the 250 us allowance, so its floor is 250e-6/2**24 = 1.4901161193847656e-11 s. Every bounded member sits exactly at that floor: the minimal L-infinity model departure is indistinguishable from zero at ~15 ps resolution, and the 250 us allowance is roughly seven orders of magnitude from binding on any surviving member. The distribution is degenerate by construction and cannot rank members; what it establishes is that no surviving member is anywhere near the gate
